name: Light Mobile Occasional
profile: Half of the base. Opened the account in the app but buys rarely (about 2 purchases a month) and spends little; almost never at OXXO.

name: Engaged Mobile Power User
profile: One third of the users and three quarters of the revenue. Frequent, diverse, high spend; already buys mostly outside OXXO.

name: Counter-onboarded Steady Spender
profile: Small group onboarded at the OXXO counter (not in the app). Active every month with steady, mid-to-high spend and the highest retention.

name: OXXO-Dependent Loyalist
profile: Half of their spend happens at OXXO. Low ticket, low diversity and low CLTV; the card works as an OXXO wallet.
